description: A company's statutory payment reports against the PPN 018 tests and the Fair Payment Code tiers. The last two Payment Practices reports read against PPN 018's tests (at least 95% of invoices paid within 60 days, 90% with an action plan; all invoices paid within an average of 45 days) and the Fair Payment Code's percentage tiers (Gold 95% within 30 days; Bronze 95% within 60; Silver can't be judged from the report). A company that doesn't report is said so.
name: ppn_018
title: PPN 018 Payment Check
